title: OTHRYS OS tablet landscape layout repair
goal: Repair the live Panda-style tablet layout using the operator screenshot: reduce rail pressure, restore readable workspace width and remove header collisions without changing authority.
laws: Use the live tablet screenshot as visual evidence.
Keep left navigation visible in tablet landscape.
Progress rail must not crush or overlap the central workspace.
Top context header must remain readable without colliding with Progress controls.
No execution, routing, project or mission semantics change.
Existing touch targets and read-only boundaries remain intact.
Desktop and narrower mobile fallbacks remain usable.
